title: Bun epoll_ctl EEXIST race and stall on the ubuntu CI leg: no open task, evidence from #775 (2026-11-23)
description:
No open task tracks the bun epoll_ctl EEXIST race on the ubuntu CI leg. LCLI-507 (retry guard), LCLI-660 (re-measure under the Bun pin) and LCLI-686 (Bun pin) are Done and are mitigation or measurement, not a fix. Filed 2026-11-23 at team-lead's request, low priority, evidence only.

EVIDENCE, 2026-11-23, opum-ai/lore-cli#775 (tracker-only diff: one .quest record moved to completed/; no test can reach it), head 9951b7aa:
- Job 137422494084 (run 45091704687 attempt 1): lint-typecheck-test (ubuntu-latest) failed; the log ends "attempt 2 ALSO failed after the race retry. The retry count stays at one by design ... this run is red and belongs to whoever can measure the race." The log holds no runtime EEXIST line (the only EEXIST text is the workflow script itself), so the retry arm fired on the bounded-timeout exit 124: a stall, test/bin-lore.test.ts then ladybug-benchmark-runner.test.ts, ~6 min.
- Job 137426386466 (same run, re-run of the failed job, attempt 2): failed again, with repeated "error: EEXIST: file already exists, epoll_ctl" in the log (first at 2026-11-23T01:10:45Z).
- Control: #774 (same kind of diff) was green on this job ~1h earlier.
- Rate, measured: of the 20 most recent ci.yml pull_request runs for PRs into dev (#753-#775), latest-attempt ubuntu job: 19 success, 1 failure (#775). Two of the 20 runs needed a re-run (#756, #775). The earlier main push run 45005825388 on c57a9a88 also failed here (re-run green), per LCLI-821, outside that count.
- Latest-attempt counts hide a failure that a re-run cleared, and hide the job's own internal attempt 1.
OPEN QUESTION: whether the bare-timeout stall and the EEXIST error are one cause. Not established.
